rationale: C11 is a concrete and material drafting template for the child. Both orders transfer jurisdiction over Bankhead-Jones lands from Agriculture to Interior, carry associated water rights, improvements, and structures with the lands, prescribe administration under the Taylor Grazing Act, defer transfer of lands still being acquired until acquisition is complete, and then enumerate land-utilization projects and acreage. The child adapts this machinery by broadening Interior's permitted authorities and adding revenue-distribution terms. C13 and C19 contain nearly the same operative formula, but C11 is the strongest full-order antecedent and even covers the Cuba-Rio Puerco project later included in the child.

shared_material.child_excerpt: Subject to valid existing rights, jurisdiction over the lands ... acquired or in the process of acquisition by the Secretary of Agriculture under the provisions of section 32 of the BankheadJones Farm Tenant Act ... or transferred to the Secretary of Agriculture for use, administration, and disposition in accordance with the provisions of Title III of that act
shared_material.parent_excerpt: Subject to valid existing rights, jurisdiction over all lands in the following-described areas acquired or in process of acquisition under Title III of the Bankhead-Jones Farm Tenant Act, or transferred ... to the Secretary of Agriculture for use, administration and disposition in accordance with the provision of the said Act
shared_material.explanation: Distinctive parallel opening that identifies the same categories of Bankhead-Jones lands held by Agriculture.

shared_material.child_excerpt: together with title and use records, water or water rights, improvements, appurtenances, and structures acquired, constructed, or used in connection with the use and administration of such lands, is hereby transferred from the Department of Agriculture to the Department of the Interior
shared_material.parent_excerpt: together with waters or water rights, improvements, and structures acquired or constructed in connection with the use and administration of said lands, is hereby transferred to the Department of the Interior
shared_material.explanation: Closely shared conveyance formula transfers both jurisdiction and associated property or records from Agriculture to Interior.

shared_material.child_excerpt: for use, administration, or exchange under the applicable provisions of the Taylor Grazing Act (48 Stat. 1269), as amended
shared_material.parent_excerpt: and the lands shall be administered under the Taylor Grazing Act, 48 Stat. 1269 (43 U.S.C. 315), as amended
shared_material.explanation: The child retains the same Taylor Grazing Act administrative machinery while expanding the available authorities.

shared_material.child_excerpt: Provided further, that the transfer of jurisdiction over those lands that are in process of acquisition shall take effect upon the completion of acquisition thereof by the Secretary of Agriculture
shared_material.parent_excerpt: Provided, That the transfer of jurisdiction over those lands that are in process of acquisition shall take effect upon the completion of acquisition thereof by the Secretary of Agriculture
shared_material.explanation: This is essentially verbatim, distinctive contingency language governing lands still being acquired.
The child applies the inherited transfer framework to a project already covered by C11, alongside additional projects and revised land descriptions.
